meta.source: Nightlife Culture Style Guide v1.5.1 + live reference decks in reference/
meta.note: A pattern is a slide arrangement a real deck has used, built from the blocks in foundations/nightlife-slides.css. Patterns grow from live work: a new reference slide either fits a pattern here, or is composed from blocks and added as a new pattern citing that slide. Replaces the twelve generated layouts (archived 29 Sep 2026).
meta.howToGrow: 1. Put the live deck in reference/<name>/ (PDF plus one image per slide). 2. For each slide, find the pattern it fits. 3. If none fits, compose it from blocks in a deck JSON, add a pattern entry here with its reference slide, and rebuild. 4. If a block itself is missing, that is a gap: log it in docs/gaps.md — a block changes only when a token changes.

statement.name: Statement
statement.useWhen: One big idea, with a few sentences that explain it.

statement-two-columns.name: Statement and two columns
statement-two-columns.useWhen: A defining line, then two short columns that unpack it.

three-columns.name: Three columns
three-columns.useWhen: Three related points, each with a heading and a short paragraph. Optional lead above and a callout or closing line below.

three-boxes.name: Three filled boxes
three-boxes.useWhen: Three parallel areas, each important enough to hold its own filled block.

text-and-side-block.name: Text and side block
text-and-side-block.useWhen: Main text in columns, plus one thing different in kind set apart in an accent block at the right edge.

steps.name: Steps
steps.useWhen: A method or process of up to eight steps, read left to right. One filled cell may carry the summary.

list.name: Labelled list
list.useWhen: Named groups, each with one or two lines of description: partners, roles, audiences.

two-by-two.name: Two by two
two-by-two.useWhen: Four questions or workstreams of equal weight. Optional label above and a closing line or band below.
blocks: columns ×2, two rows (left rule or plain)

phases.name: Phases
phases.useWhen: Periods of time and what happens in each, with a milestone.

table.name: Table
table.useWhen: Figures that have to be read row by row, such as a budget. For decks that are sent and read, not projected.

team-and-close.name: Team and close
team-and-close.useWhen: Who is doing the work, ending on the offer in a closing band with the wordmark.
